{{Quote|Are the Imperial troops near this planet?''"<br />"''They are here, friend, and growing more powerful.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] discuss the Empire's presence near Panna|<ref name="TSOTFW" />}}
'''Panna''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], orbited by [[Panna Prime]] and two other moons.

==History==
[[File:Pannasquared.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Panna and two moons, seen from [[Panna Prime]]'s surface.]]
Panna was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], orbited by [[Panna Prime]] and at least two other moons.<ref name="TSOTFW" />

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] first encountered [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on the planet's moon Panna Prime while returning a mystical artifact.<ref name="TSOTFW" />
